description: Fetch the requests an IP made: time, app key, route, method, status code, duration and user agent, newest first. Covers the last 24 hours unless from/to are given, up to 500 requests per telemetry store, across every app unless appKeys are given; the response states the window.

appKeys.description: Application key or comma-separated/list of application keys.

environment.description: Deployment environment scope: production, staging, preview, local, test, or all. Default for investigations is production.

from.description: Start time as ISO 8601. Defaults to 24 hours before to.

to.description: End time as ISO 8601. Defaults to now.

name: securenow_ip_traces
title: IP Traces
